function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT sku,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-08' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_aug,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-09' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_sep,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-09' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-08' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS delta_qty
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY sku
ORDER BY ABS(delta_qty) DESC
LIMIT 20","purpose":"SKU-level quantity change"}
